meta_description:
822 likes, 40 comments - peyushbansal on August 21, 2026: "70,000 Indians laced up for someone they'll never meet. 👥

Last weekend was Drishti ki Daud - Run for Vision. 21,107 of you crossed 20,000 steps. Because of that, 33,600 pairs of glasses are on their way to people who need them - thank you Lenskart Foundation team 🙏

You asked for more time. So the run continues...now through 31 August.

Not too late to join: open the Lenskart app → Run for Vision, connect your health app, and start walking. 

For your own health, and for someone else's sight.
Jai Hind. 🇮🇳

#RunForVision #DrishtiKiDaud #IndependenceDay #VisionForBillion".
